description: 🏠 Apartment located on the 2nd floor with elevator📐 98 m²❄️Air conditioning/ ☀️Heating🛋️ Living room with sofa bed for 2 people📺 TV and WiFi🍳 Open-plan kitchen equipped with an oven, microwave, kettle, coffee machine and dishwasher🍽️ Dining area for 8 people🛏️ 3 comfortable bedrooms with queen size beds🛁 1 bathroom with bathtub +🚿shower +🚽toilet 🚿 1 shower room + 🚽 toilet Umbrella 👶 bed available in the apartment 🧺 Towels and bed linenThe space✨🏠 Discover this charming apartment conveniently located in the heart of Paris, just an 11-minute walk from the famous Palais Garnier and 15 minutes from the Louvre Museum. Combining modernity and elegance, it offers refined accommodation for 8 people, including three comfortable bedrooms with a queen-size bed, and a sofa bed in the living room.Fully equipped, it combines comfort and privileged location, creating a warm atmosphere for an unforgettable stay in the French capital.Guest access🔑Access to this apartment is self-contained. However, we are available 7 days a week to help if you need us. You can contact us through the booking platform.Other things to noteThe apartment is located on the 2nd floor with elevator elevator.
